title: TAX INVOICE
key_sentences: Please pay by bank transfer and quote the invoice number as the payment reference.
Payments received after the due date may incur interest at 4% above the Bank of England base rate.
Goods remain the property of Brackwater Office Supply Ltd until this invoice has been paid in full.
Any damage or shortfall must be reported within five working days of delivery.
Chairs and desks carry a five-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
We look forward to working with you again.

notes: Commercial tax invoice, one page. The BILL TO and SHIP TO blocks sit side by side; read box by box (BILL TO first). Their uppercase captions and the invoice meta labels are field labels, not headings.
